units.rawText: Nanaka's proclamation infects the entire room with a frigid gloom.
units.displayText: Nanaka's proclamation infects the entire room with a frigid gloom.

spans.text: Nanaka's proclamation infects the entire room with a frigid gloom.

units.rawText: You didn't do shows!? But why?
units.displayText: You didn't do shows!? But why?

spans.text: You didn't do shows!? But why?

units.rawText: Your voice is so amazing, plus you're the lead singer; surely you could have the AI synthesize a voice to be your backup!
units.displayText: Your voice is so amazing, plus you're the lead singer; surely you could have the AI synthesize a voice to be your backup!

spans.text: Your voice is so amazing, plus you're the lead singer; surely you could have the AI synthesize a voice to be your backup!

units.rawText: No, that's not right. You're a member of the Cloud Sector to begin with, so how did you end up here in the Burbank Sector...?
units.displayText: No, that's not right. You're a member of the Cloud Sector to begin with, so how did you end up here in the Burbank Sector...?

spans.text: No, that's not right. You're a member of the Cloud Sector to begin with, so how did you end up here in the Burbank Sector...?

units.rawText: And why...
units.displayText: And why...

spans.text: And why...

units.rawText: You have too many questions. Where should I begin?
units.displayText: You have too many questions. Where should I begin?

spans.text: You have too many questions. Where should I begin?

units.rawText: I'm sure some other important things have slipped my mind, but the biggest issue right now is—why aren't you singing anymore!?
units.displayText: I'm sure some other important things have slipped my mind, but the biggest issue right now is—why aren't you singing anymore!?

spans.text: I'm sure some other important things have slipped my mind, but the biggest issue right now is—why aren't you singing anymore!?

units.rawText: Idols need to meet expectations. That's why they're called idols.
units.displayText: Idols need to meet expectations. That's why they're called idols.

spans.text: Idols need to meet expectations. That's why they're called idols.

units.rawText: But nobody wants to hear me sing anymore.
units.displayText: But nobody wants to hear me sing anymore.

spans.text: But nobody wants to hear me sing anymore.

units.rawText: Says who? I've always been waiting for you!
units.displayText: Says who? I've always been waiting for you!

spans.text: Says who? I've always been waiting for you!

units.rawText: Kuro takes out her push-button cellphone and shows Nanaka the screen.
units.displayText: Kuro takes out her push-button cellphone and shows Nanaka the screen.

spans.text: Kuro takes out her push-button cellphone and shows Nanaka the screen.

units.rawText: You see, they're screenshots I took even before coming to PNC. Your loyal fans are all waiting, and even your ordinary fans want to hear you sing!
units.displayText: You see, they're screenshots I took even before coming to PNC. Your loyal fans are all waiting, and even your ordinary fans want to hear you sing!

spans.text: You see, they're screenshots I took even before coming to PNC. Your loyal fans are all waiting, and even your ordinary fans want to hear you sing!

units.rawText: That's what I thought when I first came to Burbank.
units.displayText: That's what I thought when I first came to Burbank.

spans.text: That's what I thought when I first came to Burbank.

units.rawText: But... I know that idols are useless here.
units.displayText: But... I know that idols are useless here.

spans.text: But... I know that idols are useless here.

units.rawText: What kind of nonsense is that? Those Cyber [BLEEPS] on the net couldn't come up with anything like what you...
units.displayText: What kind of nonsense is that? Those Cyber [BLEEPS] on the net couldn't come up with anything like what you...

spans.text: What kind of nonsense is that? Those Cyber [BLEEPS] on the net couldn't come up with anything like what you...

units.rawText: [Uncivilized language detected...]
units.displayText: [Uncivilized language detected...]

spans.text: [Uncivilized language detected...]

units.rawText: Sorry, that wasn't directed at you. I'm just saying, why do you think that?
units.displayText: Sorry, that wasn't directed at you. I'm just saying, why do you think that?

spans.text: Sorry, that wasn't directed at you. I'm just saying, why do you think that?

units.rawText: ...Kuro, did you hear about "that incident"? I guess you didn't. It's top secret even within Cyber Media.
units.displayText: ...Kuro, did you hear about "that incident"? I guess you didn't. It's top secret even within Cyber Media.

spans.text: ...Kuro, did you hear about "that incident"? I guess you didn't. It's top secret even within Cyber Media.

units.rawText: Hear about... what?
units.displayText: Hear about... what?

spans.text: Hear about... what?

units.rawText: Actually, the pink-haired idol who sang and danced in front of the masses wasn't my real appearance.
units.displayText: Actually, the pink-haired idol who sang and danced in front of the masses wasn't my real appearance.

spans.text: Actually, the pink-haired idol who sang and danced in front of the masses wasn't my real appearance.

units.rawText: This unassuming Nanaka who stands before you is what my original body looks like.
units.displayText: This unassuming Nanaka who stands before you is what my original body looks like.

spans.text: This unassuming Nanaka who stands before you is what my original body looks like.

units.rawText: It's just that before my debut performance, this body suddenly malfunctioned, and I had to switch to the Nanaka body that everyone's familiar with. My debut was a success, and they went with that image.
units.displayText: It's just that before my debut performance, this body suddenly malfunctioned, and I had to switch to the Nanaka body that everyone's familiar with. My debut was a success, and they went with that image.

spans.text: It's just that before my debut performance, this body suddenly malfunctioned, and I had to switch to the Nanaka body that everyone's familiar with. My debut was a success, and they went with that image.

units.rawText: But how...! I knew it! The lot at Cyber Media are so damn unprofessional!
units.displayText: But how...! I knew it! The lot at Cyber Media are so damn unprofessional!

spans.text: But how...! I knew it! The lot at Cyber Media are so damn unprofessional!

units.rawText: Laughable, isn't it? The body and neural cloud had nothing to do with each other. Therefore I was always afraid because I didn't know whether the "Nanaka" that everyone loved was my body or my neural cloud.
units.displayText: Laughable, isn't it? The body and neural cloud had nothing to do with each other. Therefore I was always afraid because I didn't know whether the "Nanaka" that everyone loved was my body or my neural cloud.

spans.text: Laughable, isn't it? The body and neural cloud had nothing to do with each other. Therefore I was always afraid because I didn't know whether the "Nanaka" that everyone loved was my body or my neural cloud.

units.rawText: That was why when I joined Project Neural Cloud, I specifically chose to have my neural cloud projection be of my original body. I wanted to know if people would still accept my heart, even without "Nanaka's" looks.
units.displayText: That was why when I joined Project Neural Cloud, I specifically chose to have my neural cloud projection be of my original body. I wanted to know if people would still accept my heart, even without "Nanaka's" looks.

spans.text: That was why when I joined Project Neural Cloud, I specifically chose to have my neural cloud projection be of my original body. I wanted to know if people would still accept my heart, even without "Nanaka's" looks.

units.rawText: And in the end, I failed completely.
units.displayText: And in the end, I failed completely.

spans.text: And in the end, I failed completely.

units.rawText: You failed?
units.displayText: You failed?

spans.text: You failed?

units.rawText: The people here didn't like my songs.
units.displayText: The people here didn't like my songs.

spans.text: The people here didn't like my songs.

units.rawText: See, even the rebuilding of this stage was only funded by one person, no?
units.displayText: See, even the rebuilding of this stage was only funded by one person, no?

spans.text: See, even the rebuilding of this stage was only funded by one person, no?

units.rawText: I only managed to sell one album here. Everything I've done was nothing compared to the happiness that your livestream brought!
units.displayText: I only managed to sell one album here. Everything I've done was nothing compared to the happiness that your livestream brought!

spans.text: I only managed to sell one album here. Everything I've done was nothing compared to the happiness that your livestream brought!

units.rawText: ...Huh?
units.displayText: ...Huh?

spans.text: ...Huh?

units.rawText: You think so too, don't you?
units.displayText: You think so too, don't you?

spans.text: You think so too, don't you?

units.rawText: Compared to my soulless singing, your livestream has given real hope to the people of the Entertainment Sector!
units.displayText: Compared to my soulless singing, your livestream has given real hope to the people of the Entertainment Sector!

spans.text: Compared to my soulless singing, your livestream has given real hope to the people of the Entertainment Sector!

units.rawText: Ah... Actually, I bought that CD.
units.displayText: Ah... Actually, I bought that CD.

spans.text: Ah... Actually, I bought that CD.

units.rawText: ...Eh!? But why?
units.displayText: ...Eh!? But why?

spans.text: ...Eh!? But why?

units.rawText: Do you still remember when I got fired by Cyber Media? Back then, my manager and I nearly ended up on the streets...
units.displayText: Do you still remember when I got fired by Cyber Media? Back then, my manager and I nearly ended up on the streets...

spans.text: Do you still remember when I got fired by Cyber Media? Back then, my manager and I nearly ended up on the streets...

units.rawText: But the one who helped me get out of that rut and restart my streaming career was you, Nanaka!
units.displayText: But the one who helped me get out of that rut and restart my streaming career was you, Nanaka!

spans.text: But the one who helped me get out of that rut and restart my streaming career was you, Nanaka!

units.rawText: When I lost my job, all I could do was lie on my bed and swipe on my phone, the grandeur of "NotREAL?"'s online concert made me remember the joy of being a streamer...
units.displayText: When I lost my job, all I could do was lie on my bed and swipe on my phone, the grandeur of "NotREAL?"'s online concert made me remember the joy of being a streamer...

spans.text: When I lost my job, all I could do was lie on my bed and swipe on my phone, the grandeur of "NotREAL?"'s online concert made me remember the joy of being a streamer...

units.rawText: More importantly, it was Nanaka's song and Nanaka's smile that gave me the determination to spread joy to the entire world!
units.displayText: More importantly, it was Nanaka's song and Nanaka's smile that gave me the determination to spread joy to the entire world!

spans.text: More importantly, it was Nanaka's song and Nanaka's smile that gave me the determination to spread joy to the entire world!

units.rawText: This... I didn't expect this at all..
units.displayText: This... I didn't expect this at all..

spans.text: This... I didn't expect this at all..

units.rawText: So... you've been waiting for me all this time? Even though I'm not in my original body?
units.displayText: So... you've been waiting for me all this time? Even though I'm not in my original body?

spans.text: So... you've been waiting for me all this time? Even though I'm not in my original body?

units.rawText: I love your voice!
units.displayText: I love your voice!

spans.text: I love your voice!

units.rawText: Plus, you look super cute as you are now. We go great together, don't we?
units.displayText: Plus, you look super cute as you are now. We go great together, don't we?

spans.text: Plus, you look super cute as you are now. We go great together, don't we?

units.displayText: Nanaka looks dumbly at Kuro. Kuro tilts her head and smiles, then orders her drone to fly over and lightly touch Nanaka's halo.

spans.text: Nanaka looks dumbly at Kuro. Kuro tilts her head and smiles, then orders her drone to fly over and lightly touch Nanaka's halo.

units.rawText: I like you the way my drone likes your halo. That hasn't changed one bit since coming to Magrasea.
units.displayText: I like you the way my drone likes your halo. That hasn't changed one bit since coming to Magrasea.
